source.check: names and divisions read on the page image of the Northern Whig nominations report of 7 May 1927, and the Monea poll read in the Northern Whig of 4 June 1927

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled on Thursday 2 June 1927 (queue nominal 26 May). Only Monea was contested; the other divisions were filled by single nominations and are listed from the nomination report. No candidates were nominated for Drumand or Kinglass, where the sitting members continued in office. Filed on 1927-05-25, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Fermanagh that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1927-06-02 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
